<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
a=current_frame.ascii.split("\n")
seg=current_frame.segmentation
d={}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels']==36:
        rr,cc=n['boundary'][0]
        if rr>=36 and cc>=36:
            d[((rr-36)//8,(cc-36)//8)]=n['color']
cur=lambda r,c: d.get((r,c),'.')
def mini(oy,ox): return [ "".join(a[oy+i][ox:ox+6]) for i in range(6) ]
m=mini(44,44)
tgt={}
for r in range(3):
    for c in range(3):
        if (r,c)==(1,1): continue
        ch=m[2*r][2*c]
        tgt[(r,c)] = 'R' if ch=='W' else ('b' if ch=='g' else '?')
print("cur:", " | ".join(" ".join(cur(r,c) for c in range(3)) for r in range(3)))
print("tgt:", " | ".join(" ".join(tgt[(r,c)] if (r,c)!=(1,1) else '.' for c in range(3)) for r in range(3)))
diff=[(r,c) for (r,c) in tgt if cur(r,c)!=tgt[(r,c)]]
print("diff cells:",diff)
clicks=[{'action':'MOUSE','row':36+8*r+3,'col':36+8*c+3} for (r,c) in diff]
print("clicks:",clicks)
res=action(clicks)
print("level_completed:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'),"done:",last_action_result.get('done'),
      "game_over:",last_action_result.get('game_over'),"board_changed:",last_action_result.get('board_changed'),
      "reward:",last_action_result.get('reward'))
seg=current_frame.segmentation
d={}
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['pixels']==36:
        rr,cc=n['boundary'][0]
        if rr>=36 and cc>=36:
            d[((rr-36)//8,(cc-36)//8)]=n['color']
print("BR now:", " | ".join(" ".join(d.get((r,c),'.') for c in range(3)) for r in range(3)))
print("step:",current_frame.step,"level:",current_frame.level)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
